question: What share of all observed adjacent tick edges and raw-visible active edges can the current default simulator API execute and match?

method.first_observation: Retain the first observation in each contiguous scope/world-tick run; repeated polls within that run are not separate edges. Scope is document_id, match_id, player_id.
method.all_denominator: Every adjacent retained distinct-observation edge, including scope changes and skipped/missing ticks. Gaps are explicit rejected edges; same-scope consecutive edges are a separate subdenominator.
method.active: Determined from raw observation values before simulator conversion. Excludes timestamps, world tick, knowledge/provenance wrappers, force observer IDs/confidence. Semantic fields include all known effects and known optional supply-line values. Unknown optional supply-line values alone do not make an otherwise complete signature incomplete. Incomplete signatures remain ACTIVE_UNKNOWN unless a same-known-field semantic difference establishes ACTIVE_KNOWN.
method.execution: For same-scope consecutive edges only: from_canonical(before), step(before) with default Scenario/no inferred actions/combat/supply-line/terminal premises, then exact full signature comparison with from_canonical(after). Success, mismatch, rejection, and coverage gap are mutually exclusive.
method.gap_precedence: Scope/tick discontinuity is classified as REJECTED_OBSERVATION_GAP before execution; it remains in ALL denominator.
method.candidate_events: Observed new force track and raw state-change patterns are independent diagnostics. A new track is only CANDIDATE with actor/cause UNKNOWN; a due production phase is potential, not observed production. Unit increases and owner changes are descriptive candidates, not proof of production, capture, or actor.
method.decision_metrics: Ownership/unit metrics apply to comparable endpoints. Current-leg ETA agreement is predicted motion estimator versus observer estimate, not actual arrival error; actual-arrival tick error remains UNKNOWN. An observed owner change is not automatically a capture or winner label.
method.multi_blockers: Primary blocker is the API's first refusal. Separate per-tower/per-force isolated step probes are overlapping diagnostics only, sampled to a fixed maximum per cohort, never counted as whole-state acceptance.
method.sampling_risk: Six retained, preselected development/holdout sessions are not a random sample of global gameplay.

root_acceptance.independent_edge_reproduction: All 13059 edge records agree after normalizing ordering of observer-ID diagnostic lists; all metric totals and hashes agree exactly.
root_acceptance.historical_manifest_drift: 14 historical core hashes differ. Raw and corpus pins pass. Accepted descriptive results use the explicitly hashed current core; they do not reproduce historical core output.

unknown_activity.bound_assumption: Only activity of these 61 unexecutable edges is unknown; hypothetical execution is not credited.

next_P0.name: CURRENT_LEG_PATH_INPUT_COVERAGE
next_P0.evidence: 4766 known-active first refusals lack current-leg source/destination inputs; supply and combat are not dominant primary active blockers.
next_P0.scope: Offline audit of field completeness, unknown reasons and visible endpoint recoverability in existing recordings. Preserve Unknown, foreign visibility boundaries and provenance. No inferred terminal routes, hidden state, live collection, callback/queue/canvas research in this phase.
next_P0.gate: Predeclare a bounded repair only after existing-data evidence proves a reliable currently observable endpoint; rerun unchanged ALL/ACTIVE denominators and report coverage gain plus newly exposed blockers. Never relax truthful input gates to inflate coverage.

root_acceptance.true_event_coverage: UNKNOWN: raw candidate incidences do not certify causal event labels. Missing event truth cannot be dropped.
root_acceptance.mismatch_cause: All 15 comparable mismatches contain reliable NEW_TRACK candidates; actor/cause UNKNOWN, not 15 proved rule bugs or human actions.

external_action_unaccounted_overlap.rule: Do not double count primary mismatches; actor and cause UNKNOWN.

edge_audit.format: complete original edge with cohort and split per JSONL row; deterministic gzip mtime 0
